meta.description: Machine-readable beta scope classification for all product areas

classification.beta-core: Must ship in beta. Without this, the product is incomplete.
classification.beta-important: Should ship if time allows. Strengthens product but not blocking.
classification.post-beta: Explicitly deferred. Valuable but scope-dangerous for beta.
classification.scope-killer: Marked as dangerous for scope. Must not enter beta planning.

areas.title: Existing Features (behalten)
areas.description: All 28 implemented features remain. No removals.

areas.title: Bug-Fixes (Vertrauensschutz)
areas.description: Trust-critical bugs that must be fixed before beta.

areas.title: Budget Hardening (Light)
areas.description: Brutto/Netto toggle, expanded expense categories, Schulden integration, IPV in budget, insurance in budget, calm language.

areas.title: Household Model (Minimal)
areas.description: Adults + children (with age) + retired flag. Nothing more.

areas.title: Export: Meine Unterlagen (2 Dossiers)
areas.description: New route #/unterlagen + Lebensmappe PDF + Notfalldossier PDF.

areas.title: Hardcoded German Fix
areas.description: cantonalData.js and premiumCalc.js return German strings instead of i18n keys.

areas.title: Emotionale Temperatur schwerer Screens
areas.description: SozialhilfeView, SchuldenManager, TaxCalculator — warmer, supportiver machen.

areas.title: AHV/BVG/ALV Basis-Orientierung
areas.description: Info sections, not calculators. What is it? What must I do? Where do I go?

areas.title: Vorsorge-Dokument-Existenz-Checks
areas.description: Patientenverfuegung, Vorsorgeauftrag, Bestattungswuensche: existence check + upload reference.

areas.title: AHV-Nummer Masking
areas.description: Visual masking of sensitive AHV numbers in UI.

areas.title: Phase 1 Governance Runtime
areas.reason: Over-engineering for single-user local-first app. No user-facing value. Months of work.
areas.exception: E2E tests, Mobile QA, Dark Mode QA, Performance Gate — these are quality items, not governance.

areas.title: Phase 2 Workflow Engine
areas.reason: DAG executor, rollback engine, policy engine — standalone platform within platform. Zero user need.

areas.title: AI Agents & Assistants
areas.reason: Requires governance runtime. App is deterministic-first. AI Act compliance is regulatory complex.

areas.title: Multi-Account & Rollen
areas.reason: Requires backend, auth, sync — none of which exist.

areas.title: REST API & externe Schnittstellen
areas.reason: Local-first app. No backend. mailto: is the only beta-relevant exception.

areas.title: Scanner-Systeme (OCR)
areas.reason: Tesseract.js is 4MB+. Fragile on mobile. KK-Scanner QR already exists.

areas.title: Remaining 15 Generators
areas.reason: Each needs cantonal variants. Legally sensitive (PV, Vorsorgeauftrag). Template Engine must exist first.

areas.title: Full cantonal coverage (new features)
areas.reason: IPV covers 26 cantons. New features start with 5-6 reference cantons (ZH, BE, BS, GE, LU, TI).

areas.title: Document Extensions
areas.reason: OCR, versioning, full-text search, relations — useful but not essential.

areas.title: Reminder Extensions
areas.reason: Smart intervals, push notifications, life-event checklists.

areas.title: UX Extensions
areas.reason: Romansh, TTS, pictogram flows, spider web viz, global search, keyboard shortcuts.

areas.title: Security Extensions
areas.reason: WebAuthn, 2FA, pen test — important for production, not for local-only beta.

areas.title: Long-term Vision
areas.reason: Mobility module, inventory, community, mini-jobs, monetization, sustainability.

summary.focus_ratio: 51 of 260 items (19.6%) — that is the beta.
